name: life_dew_phantom_force
purpose: Life Dew of Milotic with its ally Gengar in the charge turn of Phantom Force (decision 0015 entry 5ee, issue 672): the Invulnerability step (hitStepInvulnerabilityEvent) gives -miss|Milotic|Gengar and Gengar leaves the targets before its TryHit, so it is not healed. Step 1: Milotic at full HP fails, [spread] with no slot. Step 2: Gengar's locked Phantom Force has run, so Life Dew heals both (the control). Step 3: Gengar charges again, hurt: -miss, and only Milotic is healed ([spread] of the user alone).
